The result converts the induced-component polynomial into complete abelian-subalgebra enumerations, proves exact recovery and graph-invariant separation limits, and describes smooth support strata. It supplies an infinite-family classification beyond earlier maximum-dimensional counts, with a concrete path-polynomial evaluation and Q-equivalent nonisomorphic-tree boundary.
